caption:
ICYMI: 4⭐️ Vanderbilt Star WR transfer Tre Richardson has Committed to Louisville‼️

The 5'10", 175lb receiver was an absolute playmaker for Vanderbilt, playing in all 13 games and starting 12 of them. He finished third on the team in receptions (46) while leading the team in receiving yards (806) and touchdowns (7). His 17.5 yards per catch ranked 5th in the SEC and 11th among Power Conference receivers.

He was also Vanderbilt’s primary kickoff returner, totaling 17 returns for 427 yards. His 25.1 yards per return ranked 2nd in the SEC (behind LSU’s Barion Brown) and 7th among Power Conference players. Add in 11 rushes for 62 yards, and Richardson finished with 1,295 all-purpose yards.

📊 395 yards after the catch in 2025 — 7th-most in the SEC

Richardson ranks as the No. 19 overall player in ESPN’s transfer portal rankings. Richardson took an official visit to Georgia on Tuesday before arriving in Louisville on Wednesday night. He also drew interest from Ohio State, Texas, UCLA, Auburn, Kansas State, Cal, and others.

He was one of Heisman finalist Diego Pavia’s favorite targets last season and brings serious production to the Cards!

#TransferToTheVille🔥

caption:
“I play like no one believes in me, it’s an underdog mentality for life.” @diego10pavia 

From JUCO to Heisman finalist, people may try to count him out, but QB Diego Pavia keeps finding ways to shine!

Despite Vanderbilt’s College Football Playoff Snub after a 10-2 season, Diego’s explosive play landed him a spot amongst the top ranked players in the country. 

We had a chance to chop it up with the young @vandyfootball QB and instantly understood why he is one of the biggest names in sports- his energy is high, his heart is full, and he is who he says he is..talks that talk and always ready to walk the walk- his dominant playmaking, undeniable leadership and viral moves on and of the field truly is a pivotal story. 

Family, faith and football has guided his unlikely journey to a place where he always believed he could be but was never expected to land, tap in now to hear our full conversation streaming on all audio platforms and @youtube now.

caption:
During my spring break this year, March 8 - 14, 1 will be part of a team of Vanderbilt Athletes serving in the Navajo Nation of New Mexico. We are excited to be able to use our gifts to minister to the children on the reservation, as well as serving the community by completing needed work projects. Following our time serving, we will finish our trip on a spiritual formation retreat in Zion National Park.

The people in the Navajo community are desperately in need of Jesus and spiritual direction. Many are in trouble, facing huge drug and alcohol addiction issues, family disintegration, and incredibly high suicide rates.

There are two ways that you can join in this ministry with me as I prepare to serve the Navajo Nation:

1. Pray for us. Please ask God to give my team safe travel, caring and generous hearts, and the right words to minister with. Your prayers are crucial for this trip

2. Offer financial support. If you feel called to support the work God is doing in New Mexico, please prayerfully consider providing a donation to my Go Fund Me. Your support will enable me to participate in this exciting opportunity.

This is the link to the gofundme:

https://gofund.me/bd007fce
LINK IN BIO
Taking part in a mission trip is an incredible spiritual experience. I am very excited to be a part of the work serving the Navajo people, to grow in my faith, and to share those experiences with you when I return. Thank you so much for considering supporting me through prayer and/or a financial gift.
